• To disable the GPS tracker on a Bird scooter, follow these steps:

1.  Open the Bird app on your smartphone.
2.  Tap on the "Account" or "Profile" icon (usually represented by a person's silhouette) in the top right corner of the screen.
3.  Scroll down to the "Settings" or "Account Settings" section.
4.  Look for the "Scooter Settings" or "Device Settings" option and tap on it.
5.  Locate the "Location Services" or "GPS" option and toggle the switch to the "Off" position.
6.  Alternatively, you can also go to the "Location Services" settings on your smartphone (usually found in the "Settings" app) and toggle the switch for the Bird app to the "Off" position.
7.  If you're using a Bird scooter with a physical GPS device, you may need to press and hold the power button until the device turns off.
8.  Confirm that the GPS tracker is disabled by checking the Bird app or the scooter's display (if it has one).

Note: Disabling the GPS tracker may affect the scooter's functionality, such as its ability to be tracked or locked.
